## BookLeaf Assignment 2
1. In Validate & summarise, replace YOUR-APP with your Bubble app slug and confirm notificationlog API type.
2. Bind three Header Auth credentials: BookLeaf webhook secret (X-BookLeaf-Secret), BookLeaf Bubble API (Authorization: Bearer token), BookLeaf LLM bearer token (Authorization: Bearer provider key).
3. Create a Bubble NotificationLog before invoking this webhook. request_id must equal its unique ID; author_external_id must match author_id.
4. Use private server-side Bubble API Connector calls. Never expose the webhook secret in a page URL/client.
5. Production self-hosting uses concurrency=1. Read docs/integration.md before enabling cloud concurrency.
Success means content generated and saved, not email delivered. Real email sending is optional and is not wired in this export.
